task: Prevent REVIEW and remediation DEV from alternating after each newly discovered finding by freezing one review candidate until bounded multi-lane discovery saturates.
outcome: After lattice review_inventory_begin --storyId=B-3f3d, the terminal prints an epoch ID and frozen cutoff. lattice review_inventory_status then shows every required lane, current wave, new verified findings, blockers, and one exact next command. Material writes while OPEN are rejected. Only a signed zero-new-finding receipt permits one aggregated remediation DEV transition; the repaired material then receives fresh impacted-lane review. The B-cdf6 replay report shows mutation-driven reviewer redispatches reduced from at least 5 to 0 with unchanged reviewer/host coverage and zero quality regressions.
facts: B-cdf6 mutated reviewed material after the first finding while other review lanes were still pending, invalidating work and causing RR-047 through RR-051 redispatches.
Current adversarial review already defines six canonical lenses plus a completeness critic and only converges when both add zero confirmed findings.
Current REVIEW gate requires all active receipts in round 1 but only one current receipt in round 2+, which cannot prove final review sufficiency.
ReviewRun and ReviewPass already bind current reviewRound and material hashes; these are reusable signed facts but do not define a frozen inventory epoch.
Round count is not evidence of completeness and must remain a metric only.
constraints: All gate-relevant state must be prompt-directed and mechanically enforced at handler, hook, commit, and transition boundaries.
OPEN epoch drift fails closed to INVALIDATED; stale verdicts become advisory and never authorize transition.
Required reviewer lanes and two-host assurance cannot be reduced.
Budget exhaustion cannot manufacture PASS; it must require replan, decomposition, escalation, or human adjudication.
Do not implement PRE_CERT or atomic remediation closeout in this Story.
Do not weaken evidence freshness, signatures, material lineage, or TEST/DONE gates.
The untracked cross-story analysis documents are intake evidence summarized in Story background, not runtime implementation dependencies.
The retired legacy Authority receipt guide is not normative; reuse only current local binding predicates from active lifecycle and evidence-integrity sources.
